svg.title: Order of checks in Settings when the Windows time is wrong: automatic settings, time zone, and daylight saving time
svg.desc: An English guide to the main sections of this article.

g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
Order of checks in Settings when the Windows time is
wrong: automatic settings, time zone, and daylight
saving time
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-29
Check whether automatic time setting
is enabled
Open Settings > Time & language > Date & time.
Check the time zone and daylight
saving time
Check “Set time zone automatically” on the same
screen.
Check the Windows Time service if the
time remains wrong after enabling…
Press the Windows key and R, enter services.msc
in the Run window, and find the Windows Time
service in the list.
Check the BIOS/UEFI time if the
problem persists
If the time resets every time the power is
turned off and on, you can suspect the
motherboard’s clock device or battery.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
